title: Client heartbeat, major 1
description: What a client reports about its outputs to POST /client/heartbeat, as facts rather than a verdict: which outputs exist, of what kind, whether each is connected and at what size. The server keeps it as a file beside the wall heartbeats so a curator can place a wall on an output by name; it stores nothing else about the device. Additive keys are allowed. One rule a schema cannot state: no two outputs share a name, because the name is how a wall is placed on one. Semantics are in .prawduct/artifacts/player-contract.md § Transport.

reported_at.description: The instant of the report, RFC 3339 with an offset. The pattern is what enforces the offset; 'format' alone is not checked by every validator.

outputs.description: Every output the client can drive, connected or not. Empty is allowed: a client that has found nothing to draw on says so.

name.description: The client's name for the output, stable across restarts: a DRM connector name (hdmi-a-1) or frame.

kind.description: frame: a Samsung Frame's own art store, over its network API. framebuffer: a screen this client draws to itself.

connected.description: Whether a screen is present on the output now. An unplugged or switched-off screen is false, and the output is still listed.

screen.description: [width, height] in pixels, or null when the client does not know it.
